title: No POCSO Act exception for romantic relationships involving minors: Madras High Court
description: The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court recently held that person accused in a case under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO Act) cannot defend himself on the ground that he was in a “consensual romantic relationship” with the minor victim [Arumugam Vs DSP].A Bench of Justices N Anand Venkatesh and KK Ramakrishnan observed that the POCSO Act does not recognise consent given by a person below the age of 18 years. .The Court made the observation in a case where it
